findings.summary: The section's done-when halving bound still reads 0.66 (497336320/751689728) and this commit answers the prior review's blocking finding by reclassifying the bound as unmeetable rather than meeting it, treating head's tick-1 post-release RSS of 440213504 bytes as a floor; that is one observation, so the 'no implementation could read 376 MB' claim outruns a single sample, and the coordinator's exemption of the bound is its disposition.

The run's negative control for this commit (logs/repair-negative-control.log) falsifies only the paragraph's presence, 0 at base and 1 at head, so it shows the text landed and not that its arithmetic holds; the figures are re-derived by hand in this review and nothing fails if they drift.
